{{recipe}}

This is a tasty and easy-to-make soup recipe. {{decameron}}

==Ingredients==
*¼ [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (115 g) [[Cookbook:Forcemeat|forcemeat]] of [[Cookbook:Poultry|fowl]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Potato Flour|potato flour]]
*1 tablespoon [[Cookbook:Béchamel Sauce|Bechamel sauce]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolk]]
*[[Cookbook:Pea|Pea]]s
*[[Cookbook:Asparagus|Asparagus]]
*[[Cookbook:Spinach|Spinach]]
*[[Cookbook:Clear soup|Clear soup]]

==Procedure==
#Mix the fowl with potato flour, Bechamel sauce, and the yolk.
#Put this into a tube about the size round of an ordinary [[Cookbook:macaroni|macaroni]].
#Twenty minutes before serving, squirt the forcemeat into a saucepan of boiling [[Cookbook:stock|stock]], and nip off the forcemeat as it comes through the pipe into pieces about an inch and a half long. 
#Let it [[Cookbook:simmer|simmer]], and add boiled peas and asparagus tips.
#If you like to have the fowl macaroni white and green, you can color half the forcemeat with a spoonful of spinach colouring. 
#Serve in a good clear soup.
